codes.meaning: The unit detected it lost power long enough that the freezer section warmed to 18°F or higher.
The fridge compartment stayed above roughly 48°F, or the freezer above roughly 15°F, for more than about 90 minutes.
The electronic oven control board itself, or the wiring feeding it, is likely faulty.
The oven's control board has detected a problem but can't tell what specific fault triggered it.
The circuit that reads oven temperature appears to be malfunctioning.
The oven door's locking mechanism or its switches are not behaving as expected.
Same door-latch assembly/wiring problem as F5, reported under the oven's self-clean lock circuit.
The oven's cooling fan is spinning slower than it should.
A float switch or sensor has detected water pooling in the drip tray underneath the tub.
The dishwasher is taking too long to drain, usually a clogged filter, drain hose, or disposer/air gap.
The user interface panel has lost reliable communication with the dishwasher's main control board.
The machine isn't sensing incoming water.
The thermistor or optical water-indicator sensor used to gauge tub temperature/water clarity is reporting a fault.
The dishwasher's sensors have picked up too much foam or soap suds in the tub.
